title: tag_group:character_count
body:
[See [[Tag Groups]].]

h4.How to Count the Characters in an Image

Danbooru has counter tags that are divided into three sexes: boy, girl, and other. These tags are used to count how many characters appear in a given image, where "character" refers to a sentient human or humanoid entity that is given focus in the image.

In addition to these tags, there's [[solo]] and [[solo focus]] which are used on posts with only one character, and posts with an overwhelming focus on one character, respectively (with some caveats that are explained below).

If there are some characters whose gender you can't identify, tag with [[character counter request]].

h6. Counting [[The Viewer]]

* [[The viewer]] is not counted if they don't have a body part inside the image, even if a character is talking with them.
** In this case, if there is only one character besides the viewer, it can be tagged with [[solo]].
* If a body part is visible, tag with [[pov]] and the viewer counts.

* !post #1739960: [[1girl]] + [[solo]] (talking to the viewer)
* !post #5558609: [[1girl]] + [[1other]] + [[solo focus]] ([[pov hands]])

h6. Counting [[Animal]]s, [[Creature]]s, [[Monster]]s, etc.

Animals are counted differently if they are named (they have a character tag) vs. unnamed (no character tag).

* Unnamed animals and creatures like [[slime (creature)|]]s are not counted.
** If a post only has unnamed animals, tag with [[no humans]].
* Named animals are not counted, but they do count against the [[solo]] tag.

* !post #5107325: [[1girl]] + [[solo]] (unnamed animal)
* !post #9791130: [[1girl]] (not solo due to named animal)
* !post #522084: [[animal focus]] + [[no humans]] (no counter tag)

h6. Counting Sexes

* As mentioned before, counter tags are divided into three sexes: boy, girl, and other. These tags are based on the character's [i]physical appearance[/i].
** For SFW posts (i.e., no visible genitals or breasts), go with your gut. Canon statements about the character's sex (from the artist or source material) may also apply.
** For NSFW posts, physical sex is the [i]sole factor[/i] in deciding the tag. As a rule of thumb:
*** [[penis]] -> [[1boy]]
*** [[breasts]] (with or without a penis) or [[pussy|vagina]] -> [[1girl]]
*** no visible genitals and an androgynous body -> [[1other]] (such as post #8420839)
* If the character doesn't have any distinguishing features such as a [[disembodied hand]], tag with [[1other]].
* You can ask for help by tagging [[gender request]].

h6. Counting People

* A group of unnamed [[people]] in the background or a [[crowd]] is not counted.
* Each [[clone]] counts as a separate person.
* A post with no human or human-like characters is tagged [[no humans]].
* [[Disembodied hand]]s and other body parts are counted.
* If only the hand is visible and the character is mostly [[out of frame]] they are still counted.
* Characters in a [[photo (object)|]] held by another character aren't counted even if they are named.

* !post #9704004: [[1girl]] + [[1other]] + [[solo focus]] ([[disembodied hand]])
* !post #3896682: [[1girl]] + [[1other]] + [[solo focus]] ([[out of frame]])
* !post #554354: [[1girl]] + [[solo]] (the girl in the photo isn't counted)

h6.Counting [[Multiple views]]

* Do not use [[solo]] with [[multiple views]], [[dakimakura (medium)|]], [[dual persona]] or [[time paradox]].
* If the same persona appears multiple times in a post, it's only counted one time, so 3 views of 1 girl is [[1girl]].
** The same applies for [[comic]]s.
* If different personas appear in a post, each persona is counted separately, so [[dual persona]] of a girl is [[2girls]].

* !post #2534175: [[1girl]] + [[multiple views]] (not solo)
* !post #4407573: [[2girls]] ([[Sakura Miku]] and regular [[Hatsune Miku|Miku]])

h6. When to use [[solo]] and [[solo focus]]

Tag with [[solo]] when it's:

* Only one instance of one character in the image.
* A single character with a [[zoom layer]].
* A single character talking to the viewer, and the viewer's body isn't visible in the image. 
* A single character with one or more inanimate [[doll]]s or [[photo_(object)|]]s of other characters.
* A single character with [b]unnamed[/b] pet or object characters.

Do not tag [[solo]] when it's:

* A single character is being depicted from [[multiple views]] (post #12904).
* A [[dakimakura (medium)|]] which contain [[multiple views]].
* [[Dual persona]].
* [[Time paradox]].
* A character alongside an [[animal]] or [[creature]] [b]with a character tag[/b] (talking or otherwise), such as post #9791130.

Use [[solo focus]] instead if it's:

* More than one character but only one is the focus of the image.
* A single character talking to the viewer, and the viewer's body is visible in the image (so it's tagged [[pov]]). 
* One character among a crowd of nondescript, less detailed [[people]].
* Single characters engaged in [[tag group:sex acts|sex acts]] with [[faceless]] or [[out of frame]] characters.

* !post #3093896: [[1girl]] + [[1boy]] + [[solo focus]]

h6.Female, male and other focus

If a post has a boy as the main focus of an image, tag with [[male focus]]. If the focus is other-gendered, use [[other focus]].

Danbooru does not use a [[female focus]] tag since the majority of posts focus on female characters.

* !post #4258219: [[1boy]] + [[solo]] + [[male focus]]
* !post #9563483: [[1boy]] + [[1girl]] + [[solo focus]] + [[male focus]]

h4.Counter Tags

h6.Girls

* [[1girl]]
* [[Multiple girls]] 
** [[2girls]]

** [[4girls]]
** [[5girls]]

h6.Boys

h6.Others
